name: Bank-Payment Card Data-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: payment card data (PAN with CVV/PIN/expiry, several card numbers, magnetic tracks). Monitor-only to start; OCR on so photographed cards and scanned forms are inspected. Move to BLOCK after tuning.

name: Bank-Payment Card Data-Bulk-Block
description: Inline Web DLP: block bulk card-number exports (25+ distinct PANs or 5+ track records). Enforcing by design; ships disabled so you choose when.

name: Bank-Payment Instructions-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: bank account identifiers (ABA, EU IBAN, global IBAN, SWIFT/BIC) in payment context. Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Customer PII-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: customer personal data across jurisdictions (US SSN/ITIN, UK/CA/AU/ZA and IN/SG/HK national IDs, EU/APAC passports, DOB with US licence) plus Zscaler's US PII engine. Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Customer PII-Bulk-Block
description: Inline Web DLP: block bulk customer-data exports (25+ distinct identifiers or 50+ dates of birth). Enforcing by design; ships disabled.

name: Bank-Customer Records-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: account statements, KYC/AML case files and loan applications that carry an identifier. Monitor-only.

name: Bank-MNPI-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: material non-public information, deal documents and tax forms (Zscaler's Financial Information engine). Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Confidential Markings-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: any document stamped with a bank confidentiality marking. Monitor-only; a good first rule to enable because it has almost no false positives.

name: Bank-Credentials-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: private keys and secrets (Zscaler's Private Keys engine). Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Endpoint-Monitor
description: Endpoint DLP: card data, payment instructions, customer PII and customer records leaving managed devices via removable media, printing, network shares and application file access. Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Endpoint-Bulk-Block-USB
description: Endpoint DLP: block bulk card-number or customer-data exports copied to removable drives. Enforcing by design; ships disabled.

name: Bank-SaaS File-Monitor
description: SaaS Security API: scan files at rest in onboarded file-storage tenants (OneDrive, SharePoint, Box, Google Drive) for card data, payment instructions, customer PII and customer records; report incidents. Applies to every matching onboarded tenant.

name: Bank-Email-Monitor
description: Outbound Email DLP: monitor mail leaving onboarded Microsoft 365 / Gmail tenants for card data, payment instructions, customer PII, customer records and KYC files. Monitor-only; needs an email tenant under Administration > SaaS Application Tenants.
